about: Hand-raises a middle-school (중학교 2학년) listener should and should not get from script.txt. Written by hand from the script, before any live run; a miss is a prompt or rule question, not automatically a bug. Matching: persona/type when given, and quote_contains found in the event quote (or the event quote in it), after normalizing (letters and digits only).

must.note: Used without explanation in the third sentence.
Tilt -> higher sun in summer needs 'the hemisphere leans toward the sun in summer', which is never said.
Needs 'Australia is in the southern hemisphere', never said.
Surprising claim with no reason or evidence.

must_not.quote_contains: 오늘은 계절이 생기는 이유를 설명해 볼게요
must_not.note: The introduction is not a claim.
The closing line is not a claim.
